findings.title: All 10 animated-example pages render the source code block as an unreadable 64px sliver (furo float + sphinxcontrib-video)
findings.description: Every gallery page that embeds an mp4 animation (animate, animate_MDS, animate_spin, animate_trails_mix, animate_surface_morph, chemtrails, plot_story_trajectories, plot_shape_morph, save_movie, precog) is visually broken: sphinxcontrib-video wraps the <video> in <div class="sphinx-contrib-video-container align-left"> (its default alignment) and furo.css declares 'article .align-left { clear: left; float: left; }'. The 640px floated video leaves a ~64px column in the 736px article, and the stderr output block plus the entire Python source block are laid out inside that sliver, clipped mid-character (e.g. '# sphi', '# Lice', 'fig, a'); on chemtrails 'Total running time of the script' wraps one word per line down the right margin. The example code is effectively unreadable on all 10 pages. Fix sketch: docs/_static/custom.css 'article .sphinx-contrib-video-container.align-left { float: none; clear: both; }' (or emit :align: center from the video directive).
findings.repro: cd /Users/jmanning/hypertools/docs && env MPLBACKEND=Agg PATH=/Users/jmanning/hypertools/.venv/bin:$PATH make html SPHINXBUILD=/Users/jmanning/hypertools/.venv/bin/sphinx-build && /Users/jmanning/hypertools/.venv/bin/python -m http.server 8642 -d _build/html & open http://127.0.0.1:8642/auto_examples/animate_MDS.html and run document.querySelector('.highlight-Python').getBoundingClientRect()
findings.expected: Video renders full-width followed by a normal full-width code block, as on non-animated pages (e.g. plot_basic.html)
findings.actual: .highlight-Python x=1024 w=64 inside SECTION.sphx-glr-example-title x=352 w=736; video container class 'sphinx-contrib-video-container align-left'; matched CSS rule 'article .align-left { clear: left; float: left; margin: 0px 1rem 1rem; }' (styles/furo.css); all 10 listed pages contain exactly this container

findings.title: 50 of 53 committed gallery notebooks pin their Colab install cell to dev-1.0-refactor; md5 caching means a release build will NOT refresh them
findings.description: conf.py's _install_notebook_cell() bakes the current git branch into every generated notebook's first cell, but sphinx-gallery regenerates a notebook only when the example source's md5 changes. The committed docs/auto_examples/*.ipynb therefore carry whatever branch was HEAD when each example last re-executed: 50 pin dev-1.0-refactor and 3 (animate_surface_morph, plot_datasets_tour, plot_story_trajectories) pin audit/release-1.0-2026-07. Building release docs from master with the intentionally-warm cache will ship 'Open in Colab' notebooks whose first cell installs hypertools from a stale dev branch instead of the released package (the promised 'On release this becomes: %pip install hypertools' never materializes). Release process must force notebook regeneration (delete docs/auto_examples/*.py.md5 or one make clean build on master) or make the install cell branch-independent.

findings.expected: Release-built notebooks install the released package: '%pip install -q "hypertools[interactive]"'

findings.title: Makefile html target invokes bare `python post_build.py` — breaks on python3-only systems
findings.description: docs/Makefile line 50 runs `python post_build.py` after sphinx-build. On macOS/Linux systems where only `python3` exists on PATH (the common case outside an activated venv), the html target fails AFTER a successful sphinx build, or silently runs a different interpreter than the docs venv. It only works in this audit because the venv bin dir was prepended to PATH. Fix: use $(PYTHON) with a sensible default (python3) or derive the interpreter from SPHINXBUILD.
findings.repro: grep -n post_build /Users/jmanning/hypertools/docs/Makefile; env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin make -n html 2>&1 | tail -2
findings.expected: post-build step uses an interpreter guaranteed to exist (and ideally the docs venv's)
findings.actual: Makefile:50: 'python post_build.py' (bare `python`; succeeded here only because /Users/jmanning/hypertools/.venv/bin was prepended to PATH)
